name: Wild Behavior
overview: The Scriptures reveal that wild behavior and its consequences serve as both a judgment and a symbol of desolation. In Leviticus 26:22, God warns that wild beasts will come to ravage the people and their possessions as a form of divine punishment. Isaiah 5:4 uses the image of a vineyard producing wild grapes to illustrate the fruitfulness of rebellion instead of obedience. Isaiah 13:21 describes deserted places inhabited by wild creatures and ominous beings, emphasizing the desolation that follows disobedience.
